items.name: agent-avatar
items.title: AgentAvatar
items.description: The assistant's face in your app's AI states (idle, thinking, speaking, sleeping), drawn by BotAvatar from libraries.dev.

items.name: agent-run
items.title: AgentRun
items.description: An agent doing a job on the device, step by step: each tool call with its time, approval before anything risky runs, and the answer at the end.

limits: Tool calling runs on Apple's model or a cloud model. Gemini Nano joins as soon as its tool calling leaves preview.

items.name: ask-page
items.title: AskPage
items.description: Ask about the page on screen. The answer streams in grounded in its text, with tap-to-jump quotes and follow-ups, and says when the page does not hold it.

budget.strategy: The whole page in one streamed pass when it fits; otherwise the chunks that best match the question, in page order. Quotes are checked against the page and dropped when they are not in it.

items.name: assistant-message
items.title: AssistantMessage
items.description: One reply from the on-device model: a trace of what it did, the answer streaming in, its sources, and copy or retry. Includes UserMessage for the person's turns.

items.name: auto-tag
items.title: AutoTag
items.description: Tag and category suggestions constrained to the app's own list, fuzzy-matched after the model answers.

budget.strategy: One structured call with an enum-constrained array; results fuzzy-matched to the list.

items.name: availability-gate
items.title: AvailabilityGate
items.description: Renders children only when the on-device model is ready; otherwise a quiet empty state with a way to turn it on.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: BorderBeam
items.description: A light that travels around a card's border while the model works. libraries.dev's border beam (MIT): Skia shader on iOS and Android, its CSS version on web.

items.name: bot-avatar
items.title: BotAvatar
items.description: A glossy little body with eyes that blinks, glances, hops while the model works and sleeps when idle. libraries.dev's bot avatars (MIT): Skia on iOS and Android, canvas on web.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Minimal button: ink solid, a soft raised key, and secondary variants that take the theme material (glass, Liquid Glass).

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A complete on-device conversation: streamed turns with their trace, stop mid-reply, retry, and history trimmed to the model's context.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Compact selectable pill for tags, filters, suggestions and replies.

items.name: command-bar
items.title: CommandBar
items.description: Spotlight for your app: natural language becomes one of your registered actions or routes, chosen by on-device tool calling, with preview and confirmation.
items.docs: Register actions with defineActions(); risky actions (risk: 'high') ask before running.

budget.strategy: Top 5 tools preselected by keyword relevance; the query is truncated to the budget.

limits: On Gemini Nano it picks the action from structured output instead of tool calls.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Text field in an IonBorder with AI state and confidence styling.

items.name: image-reveal
items.title: ImageReveal
items.description: An image arriving the way a diffusion model makes it: grain over a blurred field, resolved step by step.
items.docs: Pass `progress` (0–1) from your own pipeline, or `progress="auto"` to loop while you wait. `mode="ascii"` suits scans and documents; `mosaic` suits generated pictures.

items.name: inline-suggest
items.title: InlineSuggest
items.description: A text field that offers the rest of the sentence as ghost text while the person types, from the on-device model. Tab or the Add key takes it.

items.name: ion-border
items.title: IonBorder
items.description: The signature thinking border: a slow gradient light, a bright comet, or a breathing ring around any container while the AI works.

items.name: key-hint
items.title: KeyHint
items.description: Mono key caps for keyboard hints.

items.name: latency-chip
items.title: LatencyChip
items.description: Dev-only metrics pill: latency, tokens per second, provider.

items.name: liquid-metal
items.title: LiquidMetal
items.description: A ring of liquid metal around a button, a mic or an avatar, glowing while the model works. libraries.dev's metal-fx (MIT, shader from Paper Shaders, Apache-2.0): Skia on iOS and Android, WebGL on web.

items.name: model-download
items.title: ModelDownload
items.description: A thin progress line, ring or card with a tabular percentage while a model downloads.

items.name: natural-filter
items.title: NaturalFilter
items.description: A natural-language search request becomes a typed filter/sort object with editable chips.

budget.strategy: One structured call; enums, numbers and booleans refined deterministically.

items.name: on-device-badge
items.title: OnDeviceBadge
items.description: A quiet pill that says where inference runs: ON DEVICE · APPLE, LOCAL · LLAMA, CLOUD. The dot glows while thinking.

items.name: photo-caption
items.title: PhotoCaption
items.description: A photo in; a caption and accessibility alt text out, written by the on-device vision model. Streamed, editable, copyable, and handed back as alt text.
items.docs: Needs a provider with the `vision` capability. Pass `image` (uri, or base64 from expo-image-picker) or let the user take or choose one; `onUseAlt` receives the edited alt text.

budget.strategy: One image plus a short instruction; a single streamed reply of two labelled lines (caption, alt) parsed as it arrives.

limits: Runs on Gemini Nano (Prompt API) or a cloud model today; iPhone arrives with image input in Apple's model on iOS 27.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: PromptComposer
items.description: Where a person writes to the on-device model: a growing field, attachments, the model badge and a send key that becomes stop while it answers.

items.name: rewrite
items.title: Rewrite
items.description: Shorten, expand, friendlier, formal or fix grammar, streamed on device, with replace / diff / side-by-side results and accept/reject.

budget.strategy: Input is truncated to half the window so the rewrite fits in the rest.

items.name: scan-to-data
items.title: ScanToData
items.description: Camera or photo becomes structured data (receipt, business card, event, or your own schema) via on-device OCR and the local model.
items.docs: Pass `ocr` (e.g. @react-native-ml-kit/text-recognition or Apple Vision) to read photos; without it the component explains that OCR is not configured.

budget.strategy: OCR text (not the image) goes to the model; fields refined deterministically.

limits: The text in the photo comes from an OCR you pass in as `ocr` (Apple Vision or ML Kit Text Recognition). The model only turns that text into fields.

items.name: semantic-search
items.title: SemanticSearch
items.description: Search by meaning over the app's own records with a local vector index and hybrid keyword matching, showing why each result matched.

budget.strategy: Embeddings only (Apple NLContextualEmbedding, 512 dims); no LLM call. Keyword fallback without embeddings.

limits: Embeddings come from Apple (NLContextualEmbedding) or a cloud model. Without them it falls back to keyword search.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Animated container: bottom sheet, floating spotlight panel or fullscreen; glass or solid.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: ShimmerText
items.description: Text with a soft light running across it while the model works.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder with an ion shimmer.

items.name: smart-input
items.title: SmartInput
items.description: Text, voice or photo fills your zod form on device, with per-field confidence, deterministic refinement and confirm/undo.

budget.strategy: One structured call; enum/number/date fields are refined deterministically after parsing.

items.name: smart-reply
items.title: SmartReply
items.description: Three reply suggestions for the last message in a thread: chips, a stack, or ghost text inside the input, with an optional tone picker.

budget.strategy: Only the last 6 messages are sent, trimmed from the start.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: StreamingText
items.description: Token-by-token text rendering with a blinking accent caret and chunk fade-in.

items.name: summarize
items.title: Summarize
items.description: The gist of long text: card, inline, sheet or tooltip. Streams, and map-reduces input that does not fit the on-device context.

budget.strategy: Single streamed pass when the text fits; otherwise map (bullets per chunk) then reduce (streamed).

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: The container every card-shaped component draws with: solid, blurred glass, or the platform's own material (Liquid Glass on iOS 26, Material 3 on Android).

items.name: text-to-event
items.title: TextToEvent
items.description: A pasted or selected message becomes a calendar event: title, date, time, place and people fill in one by one with per-field confidence, stay editable, then go to the calendar.
items.docs: Pass `onAdd` and write the event with expo-calendar (or your API). An unclear date ("next Friday" said on a Monday, "Thursday or Friday", 05/06) is highlighted with the days it could mean, and the add key waits until one is chosen.

budget.strategy: One structured call on the message; the model copies words, then dates, times and names are resolved and checked against the message on device.

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: ThinkingIndicator
items.description: A shimmering sentence, a chrome orb, dots, line or sweep: calm signs that the on-device model is working.

items.name: tone-check
items.title: ToneCheck
items.description: Reads the tone of a draft as you type (friendly, neutral, blunt or tense, casual to formal) and offers a one-tap softer rewrite when it reads off.

budget.strategy: The draft is truncated to half the window so the softer rewrite fits in the rest; the reading is a small JSON object.

items.name: tool-confirm-card
items.title: ToolConfirmCard
items.description: Approval for any tool call: the call as a trace line, then a card with its parameters and deny or confirm.

items.name: translate
items.title: Translate
items.description: Live translation on device: the original, a row of target languages, the translation streaming in, with copy and an instant swap.

budget.strategy: Input is truncated to half the window so the translation, which can run longer, fits in the rest.

items.name: voice-input
items.title: VoiceInput
items.description: Push-to-talk that transcribes on device: the mic is the variant's key, a waveform drawn in the variant, then the transcript with Use and Retry.
items.docs: Audio capture is not bundled: pass `recorder` (expo-audio, react-native-audio-record or your own module) with `start()`, `stop()` → WAV/PCM bytes and `onLevel()`. Without one a simulated recorder runs, so the mock and the playground just work.

limits: Runs on iPhone with Apple SpeechAnalyzer. The app passes in the recorder (for example expo-audio).

items.name: voice-memo
items.title: VoiceMemo
items.description: Talk, and get the memo back as something to act on: a title, a two-line summary and the to-dos you mentioned, ticked and ready to add. All on device.

limits: Runs on iPhone: it records through VoiceInput (Apple SpeechAnalyzer), with the recorder passed in by the app.
